methodology: Market cap is FMP historical market capitalization on the entry session (last session on or before that date). Revenue, growth, net margin, and P/E use the last annual income statement with a filing date on or before entry (fiscal period end if filingDate is missing). P/E is entry market cap divided by that year's net income. PRIOR is the split-adjusted FMP close on entry versus the last session ~365 days earlier. Missing fields stay null.
